runtime_findings.finding: OPEN_REVIEW fill can exceed declared risk budget while aggregate reservation still counts only original plan risk_budget. Later trades may be admitted against understated modeled exposure.
runtime_findings.static_example: Cash100, planned budget40, fill modeled loss80 => reserved40; remaining60 permits another40 though modeled total120 exceeds cash100. No fixture executed.
runtime_findings.fix: Persist actual modeled fill exposure; reserve max(original reservation, positive actual modeled loss), or block all new entries while overbudget OPEN_REVIEW requires reconciliation. Keep realized gap risk explicitly uncapped.

runtime_findings.finding: Annotated runner fill_entry/close consume no event timestamp, availability timestamp or source, and do not advance last_at. Direct TradeMachine fill/close have no clock argument. Thus annotated paper accounting has weaker causal evidence than monthly replay and cannot establish historical chronological fills.
runtime_findings.fix: Require sourced at/known_at for all annotated execution events; apply shared coordinator validation before dispatch and update trade clock. Do not infer timestamps/fills. Standalone TradeMachine should expose/document mandatory timed coordinator or accept explicit timestamps.

runtime_findings.finding: Box permits fulltarget as a management choice, manage checks membership then passes it to move_stop, which rejects unknown management choice via ValueError. A sourced manage/fulltarget event aborts replay instead of a structured rejected event. fulltarget is TP outcome, not an SL move.
runtime_findings.fix: Distinguish SL-management labels from target outcome; reject fulltarget in manage with explicit structured reason before move_stop, keeping target trigger/fill path separate.

runtime_findings.finding: Output alias guard protects CSV only. CLI context/execution JSON may equal or hardlink SUMMARY.json or PRIVATE_execution.json in output_dir and is then overwritten after reading.
runtime_findings.fix: Pass all declared input paths into runner; check resolved/samefile aliases for all outputs against CSV/context/execution before writing; atomic replacement and explicit overwrite policy. Do not claim current guard protects all inputs.

runtime_findings.finding: Decimal.normalize() applies current decimal context precision. Distinct accepted high-precision risk_budget values can normalize to the same rounded string/fingerprint; fixed-plan comparison then cannot distinguish them. No runtime fixture run in this audit.
runtime_findings.fix: Canonicalize Decimal via exact as_tuple() coefficient/exponent with trailing-zero stripping, without context rounding; or explicitly reject unsupported precision before plan construction. Add near-boundary exact-decimal cases in next authorized test phase.

runtime_findings.finding: RawPipeline executes geometry/predicates and selected three-direction facts, but sentiment, trend, valid zones, pivots, half-leg, punch sequence and entry-specific proximity/timing remain sourced context dependencies. All 12 branch methods are callable conditional logic, not a complete autonomous raw classifier.
runtime_findings.fix: Report missing dependencies separately from rejected signals; resolve teacher evidence/classification definitions before claiming autonomous strategy/backtest completion. Preserve no invented thresholds.

runtime_findings.finding: EconomicRelease comparison is operational as a standalone helper but not called by raw/monthly runner; context JSON supplies direction permissions externally. Vintage/source assertions are caller evidence, not verified network feed, UTC conversion or surprise-to-direction model.
runtime_findings.fix: Keep explicit dependency disclosure; require historical vintage, release availability, symbol driver and sourced interpretation before expanding economic automation. No fresh feed/connection is implied.

runtime_findings.finding: Only supplied execution events generate fills/PnL. OHLC touches alone do not close a position; Bid/Ask quotes only trigger intents. Monthly cash is closed-known bookkeeping, not marked equity, maximum realized risk, swap-complete return, margin model or complete strategy profit.
runtime_findings.fix: Retain closed-known/unresolved/pending-cost separation and execution-event completeness disclosure; never promote a cash slice to full strategy return.

runtime_findings.finding: CSV SHA and context fingerprint are emitted, but exact execution_document digest and code/runtime/Decimal-context fingerprint are absent from generated result. Source labels in execution records do not identify exact source-document bytes.
runtime_findings.fix: Record hashes of all declared execution/context inputs and frozen module files plus Python/Decimal context in run receipt; keep paths and raw traces private.
